subject: Renewal activation readiness & exec availability
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Sam Keller <sam@nimblepay.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal activation readiness & exec availability

Hi Sam —

Thanks again for the strong usage this past year — really appreciate the partnership. NimblePay's renewal with the capacity uplift is coming up and I want to align on activation readiness, exec availability for an alignment review, and the near-term runbook so we can avoid any service friction during the term transition.

High-level proposal:
- Timeline: target effective date 2026-09-01; transition window Aug 30 - Sep 2 for quota increase and billing cutover.
- Exec alignment: quick 30m readout with your CTO + our Head of Sales to confirm top risks and rollback criteria.
- Ops runbook: shared checklist (attached) and a single point of contact during the window.

What I need from you this week:
1) Confirm exec availability (we can offer Tue Aug 3, Thu Aug 5, or Fri Aug 6 — please indicate preference).
2) Confirm primary procurement contact for final SOW and billing (we'll circulate a redline-ready SOW draft).
3) Any blockers on the proposed effective date (2026-09-01).

Attachments: renewal-readiness-checklist.pdf, proposed-timeline.xlsx (see attached stubs).

If those dates work I'll lock calendar invites and circulate a short mutual action list.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0123

Mina —

Appreciate the outreach and the checklist — nice summary. Quick answers:
- Exec: Fri Aug 6 (10–10:30 PT) is best for our CTO. Tue Aug 3 is possible but conflicts with a board prep.
- Procurement: Oliver Grant (cc'd) will own the SOW and billing. He prefers a clean SOW + one change log document.
- Effective date: 2026-09-01 looks fine, but finance wants the invoice issued by Aug 25. Will that be possible?

Two quick asks from our side:
- Can you include expected token throughput by endpoint in the SOW (peak vs sustained)?
- We run a compliance window the week of Aug 23 — if changes must be done during that week we may need a fallback plan.

Thanks — I'll hold Aug 6 10:00 PT for the exec readout once you confirm.

Best,
Sam Keller
VP Product, NimblePay

Folks —

Following Mina's thread with NimblePay, a quick internal rundown and owners so we don't lose momentum: 

Owners / near-term asks:
- SOW & throughput appendix: David Kim (Product Ops) — please scope the token table (peak/sustained/concurrency) and confirm any limits that must be called out. Target: Jul 21 EOD.
- Finance sign-off for invoice on Aug 25: Rishi (I'll pick this up) — need estimates from Billing to confirm cutover date. Target: Jul 22.
- Exec readout deck (capacity test highlights): Marissa Cole — short 6-slide deck, include rollback criteria and rollback SLA. Target: Aug 1.
- Ops dry-run and runbook update: Mina to coordinate with NimblePay and schedule the dry-run the week of Aug 24.

Risks to flag: 
- Compliance blackout Aug 23–27 per customer note; ops change during that week likely requires explicit waiver. 
- If procurement insists on SOW redlines past Jul 22 we risk pushing invoice issuance and missing Aug 25 invoice date.
